comment: File: speech/models.json. Purpose: the voices Audora can download (P4-01, ADR-022). Each voice is a flat, uncompressed zip on this repo's 'voices' release, built from the SHA-pinned upstream archive by scripts/build_voice_mirror.py (same bytes every run) and published by .github/workflows/voice-mirror.yml, which never replaces an asset. The app checks every download against sha256 and sizeBytes. A voice whose id matches the bundled voice (bundled-voices.json) is left out of the APK's catalog. To add or change a voice: edit its entry, run the script with --print-pins, paste file/sha256/sizeBytes. Never add Lessac/Blizzard-derived voices (lessac, amy, hfc_*, hi_IN rohan).

voices.label: English (UK), Piper cori
